name: CubingUSA Great Lakes FMC Championship 2023
information: This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. For a more normal comeptition experience, check out [CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesChampionship2023). Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at [CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesChampionship2023) during the award ceremony. This competition will take place at several different venues across the Great Lakes region. Check out the Location Tab for more details.
